name: ucode
reference: Kalantzi, Karypis (AU-DIS UCODE). Unsupervised Community Detection with modularity-based GNNs.

upstream.note: The GCN (UCODEncoder.py), loss_modularity_trace (Lossfunction.py), and utils.convert_torch_npz are imported unchanged. The patch is utils.py only: networkx to_scipy_sparse_array compat, a vectorised get_B (the original O(n^2) Python double loop is unusable at scale), and div-by-zero guards. main.py is left pristine and unused; training is run_ucode.py on the shared harness.
upstream.fixed: The number of communities is the encoder output width (hid_units), which the previous integration hardcoded at 16 while ignoring the requested count; it is now set from --clusters.

hid_dimension.doc: Hidden width of the GCN encoder. Paper uses 256 for the non-overlapping setting (128 overlapping); §5.1/§5.4, Fig 4/6 settle on 256. Settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.
